def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node")
    
    # Build a map of node by id
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track which nodes are currently retained
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    
    # Track symbols currently present in retained nodes
    symbol_count = {}
    for n in nodes:
        s = n["symbol"]
        symbol_count[s] = symbol_count.get(s, 0) + 1
    
    # Sort candidates: deepest first, then by node ID for ties
    # Process in order of decreasing depth, then increasing node ID
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        if any(c in retained for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Check if removing would leave all required symbols represented
        sym = node["symbol"]
        if sym in required_symbols and symbol_count.get(sym, 0) <= 1:
            # Removing this node would leave this required symbol unrepresented
            continue
        
        # Remove the node
        retained.remove(nid)
        symbol_count[sym] -= 1
        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }

    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing required field '{field}' in node")
    
    # Build maps
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent '{n['parent']}' not found for node '{n['id']}'")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track retained set and symbol counts
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    symbol_count = {}
    for n in nodes:
        s = n["symbol"]
        symbol_count[s] = symbol_count.get(s, 0) + 1
    
    # Sort: deepest first, then by node ID (string sort) for ties
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:

        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if node has retained children
        if any(c in retained for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Check required symbols are preserved after removal
        sym = node["symbol"]
        if sym in required_symbols and symbol_count.get(sym, 0) <= 1:
            continue
        
        # Remove the node

        symbol_count[sym] = symbol_count.get(sym, 0) - 1
        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)

        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,

    }
